title: Scientific Thinking: From Observation to Explanation
learning_outcomes: Distinguish observation, interpretation, hypothesis, model, and conclusion.
Design a repeatable investigation and measurement plan.
Compare model predictions with observations and communicate uncertainty.
Use agent assistance while independently checking its output.
Transfer inquiry practices to a new question and create a defensible next investigation.

sources.citation: OpenStax, University Physics Volume 1, Oscillations (simple pendulum section)
sources.supports: Introductory simple-pendulum model and its assumptions
